user.title: Resident pickup barcode
user.description: Enter the decoded DeviceSn/DeviceCode from your own Smartdaily pickup barcode. This is not a Samsung login, account password, or tracking number. Enter the code only here in Home Assistant.

community.title: Choose your community
community.description: Only communities already authorized for this resident device are listed.

reauth_confirm.title: Update resident DeviceCode
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid DeviceCode with access to the same community. Entity IDs will stay unchanged.

error.invalid_auth: The credential or community access was rejected. Check your resident pickup barcode.
error.invalid_tv_host: Enter a literal private IPv4 address, without a URL or port.
error.cannot_connect: The provider could not be reached or returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
error.no_communities: No authorized communities were returned for this resident device.

abort.already_configured: This resident device and community are already configured.
abort.invalid_community: The selected community is no longer available. Start again.
